text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm just curious about that "Special Extra-Carrot Set Meal"
Miss Oguri is eating...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: “Still, considering the race, eating too much isn't a good idea either.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: A balanced diet is what's important right now!
It's fine as long as you exercise later!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, of course.
I'll hold back for today...
choice_data_list: When we win the race, let's eat as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
They do say holding it in is bad for your health!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I burn off the calories in training,
there won't be any problem at all!
